name: BVW Master Closing Doc (completed from won calls)
source: Official: Google Drive 'BVW - Master Closing Doc' (sources/closing_doc.md). Its order and wording are used for C1 to C11 (intro with confidentiality and recording disclosure, discovery, isolate the real problem with cheated-on and cheated branches, current situation, what they've tried and the doubt question, why now and emotional cost, future consequences, desired situation, commitment, tie-down, transition), the written lines of the pitch (C12, C13), the temperature check (C15), the framing lines of next steps and investment (C16, C17), the first-objection pacing move (C18a to C18c) and the Barak booking link (C19). Filled from won calls (marked '(script blank: from won calls)'): the process line of the pitch, the three pillar names and content, delivery, onboarding steps, prices and payment plan, objections beyond pacing, and the live close. 14 calls read in full (12 Zoom, 2 Drive). 3 are won (Call Outcome Closed, Payment Type not Deposit or Instalment Paid): recGhnRsvZefXBVSx (individual, first month $1,500), recCs5H4hJqOJtQip (One Call Session $500) and recG83GHIMQ9gNUul (Drive, couple, first month $1,800). 5 closed on an instalment or deposit and are supporting evidence only: rec6IqrIcBNPKz9e9, recbpZf1niLOSFMfR, reckX0EYFDCGQ5w0o, recJJyTCIcSpWhIZE, recuD9fhc8NSBGK9z (Drive, $750 deposit on the individual program). 6 did not close and are the contrast set. Checks marked '(added: not in script, from call evidence)' are not in the doc and come from the won calls or from what the non-closing calls lacked. Setter context from sources/dm_framework.md and setter_sop.md: price anchor 'low-to-mid four figures', the call is with the 'Client Success Manager', live transfer by default.

offer_includes: 12 weekly 1-hour Zoom sessions with Barak (couples together and sometimes one-on-one each), homework, weekly relationship-building exercises, individual reflection prompts and couples assignments between sessions, email and phone contact with Barak. The process: find why the cheating or lying happened and trace it to its emotional and developmental origins; repair the impulse, attachment and validation systems (for the hurt partner: nervous system safety, clarity, emotional boundaries, self-trust); build new internal controls and personal authority so it does not resurface. End state: rebuild into an emotionally secure partnership, or consciously separate with closure.
rules: Run the doc in order. Do not skip the confidentiality line or the recording disclosure at the open (none of the 14 calls discloses the recording).
Do not reveal price into uncertainty. Run the temperature check and resolve the belief gap first.
Do not offer payment plans to solve an uncertainty objection. Find what they are unsure about first.
Stay silent after the future consequences question and after the price.

No outcome promise. Promise the process and the answer: by week 12 they either rebuild or separate with closure. Say it isn't about staying together at all costs. If the '80% of couples stay together' stat is used, frame it as a track record.
Never excuse the cheating and never take sides. In couples, ask both partners the key questions.
The buyer must want change for themselves, not only to keep the partner. Check this out loud.

Pitch the full 12-week program at full price first. Step down to a first month (4 sessions) or a $500 One Call Session only after the full pitch and only when the doubt is about certainty, not cash. Every step-down is credited toward the full program.
Take payment and book Barak while still on the call. 'Think about it' or 'text me' is not an ending; get a dated next step.
Do not argue with a skeptical or sales-savvy prospect about the call itself. Restate the purpose of the call and the next step.

segments.cheated_on_partner: The doc's 'if they were cheated on' branch. The hurt partner, often alone, anxious or numb, checking and replaying, unsure whether to stay; the other partner may not join. Sold on clarity, self-trust and peace either way (recGhnRsvZefXBVSx).
segments.partner_who_cheated: The doc's 'if they cheated' branch. The person who cheated or lied comes in wanting to know why and to rebuild trust; partner absent, listening in, or waiting to see change. Includes emotional cheating and porn or fantasy about real people (recuD9fhc8NSBGK9z).
segments.couple_together: Both partners on the call, sometimes one joining partway. Each sees the problem differently and they may argue on the call; get each partner's own goal, commitment and yes (recG83GHIMQ9gNUul, recbpZf1niLOSFMfR, reckX0EYFDCGQ5w0o).
segments.serial_or_compulsive: Long-running pattern (sex addiction, serial affairs, dating apps), often with past therapy or rehab that did not hold; ambivalent about wanting a relationship at all (recCs5H4hJqOJtQip).
segments.post_affair_communication: The affair is a year or more back and the live problem is now communication, withdrawal, resentment or commitment timing rather than the cheating itself (recG83GHIMQ9gNUul, rec1tlTKpupDVqmfF).
segments.other: Does not fit. Propose a label in signals[0].
